transcript: Your files stay on your Quark
You own everything you put here, and by default it lives on hardware you control. Anything that leaves it — remote access, an import from another service — happens because you switched it on.
Quark comes with no warranty and no promise about uptime or data integrity. Whatever you cannot afford to lose should exist somewhere else too.
Quark is for managing your own photos and files. What you store on it, and staying on the right side of the law while you do, is yours to answer for.
A summary, not the agreement — the full terms below are what you accept.

AutoButler (or AutoButler LLC, "we", "us", "our") means the company that owns and sells Quark and operates autobutler.org.

Quark means the personal cloud hardware product and related software experience sold or distributed by AutoButler.

Software means the Quark application and related open-source components that run on your Quark device (or other supported hardware you control). The Software is not "the AutoButler application."

Website means autobutler.org and related AutoButler-operated web properties (including waitlist and marketing pages).
